zh: 右侧栏的收起按钮只跟随当前会话。切换会话后，上一个会话保留的右侧栏不再让新会话顶栏显示收起按钮，按下收起也不会关掉上一个会话的面板
en: The right panel's collapse control follows the visible Session. A right panel retained by a conversation the reader left no longer shows the control in another conversation's header, and pressing it no longer closes that earlier panel
